title: One roti shared by four children: what fraction does each get?
description: One roti is cut into four equal pieces for four children. The video finds the share of each child and writes the division fact, the addition fact and the multiplication fact, while Keeko doubts it by dividing four by one.
teaching_notes: One idea: one whole shared equally among four gives one fourth each, and the same share can be written as a division, an addition and a multiplication. Watch for students who divide the number of children by the number of rotis.

source: One roti was shared equally by four children. What fraction
video_script.why: The child finds the share of each of four children from one roti and writes it as a division fact, an addition fact and a multiplication fact.
video_script.substitution: none: the book's own roti shared equally by four children
video_script.anchor: one roti on a plate and four children waiting to share it
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko says four divided by one, so each child gets four. There is only one roti, so nobody can get four rotis; the roti is the thing we divide, and the four children share it.
video_script.payoff_line: Each child gets one fourth of the roti

final_answer.value: Each child gets 1/4. Division fact: 1 ÷ 4 = 1/4. Addition fact: 1 = 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4. Multiplication fact: 1 = 4 × 1/4.
final_answer.spoken: each child gets one fourth, with the division, addition and multiplication facts

maths_rules: 1 roti cut into 4 equal pieces, 1 piece for each of the 4 children
each piece is 1/4 of the roti
addition fact: the 4 shares put back make the whole, 1 = 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4
multiplication fact: 4 equal shares of 1/4 make 1, so 1 = 4 × 1/4
slip: Keeko thinks 4 ÷ 1 = 4 so each child gets 4; the roti is divided, not the children
video_script.design: One idea: the whole is the thing that is divided. The roti stays on the plate and is cut into four equal pieces, one for each child.

beats.on_screen: Answer: Each child gets 1/4. Division fact: 1 ÷ 4 = 1/4. Addition fact: 1 = 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4. Multiplication fact: 1 = 4 × 1/4.
